findings.finding: onNewIntent handles deep links when activity is already running; onCreate also extracts initial intent data.
findings.reconciliation: MainActivity passes intent to authViewModel.handleDeepLink in both onCreate and onNewIntent, ensuring cold-start and warm-start OAuth completion.
AuthViewModel provides a clean presentation context provider anchored to the active UIWindowScene.
